The officer announces arrest and alleges concealment. The suspect disputes guilt; concealment must not become an independently confirmed fact.

The speaker makes a general statement about heavy cigarette taxation, not a single completed tax event or jurisdiction-specific verified advice.

The landlord asks what can be done about a leaking faucet. The question supplies neither a completed repair nor agreement.

John is the caller's supplied name in response to the reservation agent, not a vocative.

Yes answers whether the destination was already disclosed; the following sentence explains overhearing the mothers.
The isolated m. is part of 9p. m. in the previous segment, not a standalone nominal sentence. Keep quarantined until all neighbouring boundaries and the detached Now are reconciled.
That refers to the completed remittance form being presented; the question does not assert that the money transfer has completed.
Very likely concerns the suspected flu. It does not establish a diagnosis or completed recovery.
Might be seven is concessive in this reply; not a girl is an explicit negated identity. Preserve the contrast and do not infer a gendered preference as a general rule.
